Plugin.Name: Libvirt Balloon Keeper
Plugin.Overview: A conservative, dry-run-first controller for libvirt/QEMU virtio-balloon memory on Unraid. It uses native Markdown to display settings pages, requires fresh telemetry, enforces minimum and maximum targets, records decisions, and fails closed when telemetry is unavailable. The plugin manages a root-owned HTTP API on a mode-restricted Unix socket, runs a once-per-minute cron check, and stores state and audit logs under the configured persistent appdata directory.
